title: Flattening Preserves Matrix Addition
statement: For a natural number $n$ and two $n\times n$ matrices over the field with two elements, flattening their sum into a vector of length $n^2$ gives the sum of their flattened vectors.
hypotheses_covered: Both matrices are $n\times n$ matrices over the field with two elements
